deletion.title: Delete your Flovers account
deletion.instructions: To request deletion of your Flovers account and associated data, use the form below or email info@flovers.app from your registered email address. Use the subject ‘Delete my Flovers account’. You do not need to install or sign in to the app.
deletion.scope: Deletion removes your account, owned plants, tasks, journal entries and uploaded photos from the live service. Photo-file cleanup may take longer; any recovery-backup copies expire under the retention policy. Deletion cannot be undone in the app.
deletion.verification: We may verify account ownership before deletion. Never send your password. We will confirm receipt and explain the expected processing time and any applicable retention exceptions.
